Game Overview

Running in the Rain is a action game built around run, leap, and battle through a pixel-art world where rain intensifies every challenge. Armed with a resourceful box weapon, navigate perilous landscapes and outsmart monstrous foes in thrilling, endless action. The simple controls and dynamic weather create endless excitement and strategic gameplay. Prepare for an exhilarating escape in "Running in the Rain."
